items.headline: Mercedes-Benz Cars sales fall 9% in 2025
items.driver: Tariffs and a competitive market, especially in the U.S. and China; U.S. stock management.
items.customer_relevance: Even the strongest premium badge loses volume when product/tech value lags local rivals.
items.quote: Mercedes-Benz Cars ... 1,800,800 units (-9%)

items.notes: Conflicts with Mercedes group figure 551,900 (cars). Also: 'planning to launch more than 15 new models, including the locally produced long-wheelbase all-electric GLC SUV.'
